samples.xml_description:
<module id="clkgenerator">
	<description>A clock generator module that generates a periodic clock signal based on the PERIOD parameter.</description>
	
	<ports>
		<output id="clk">The output clock signal generated by the module.</output>
	endports
	
	<parameter_description>
		<param id="PERIOD">The period of the clock signal, which determines the frequency.</param>
	endparameter_description
	
	<logic_description type="combinational_logic">
		reg [31:0] counter;
		wire next_clk;
		
		initial begin
			counter = 0;
		end
		
		assign next_clk = ~clk;
		always @(posedge clk) begin
			if(counter >= PERIOD/2 - 1) begin
				counter <= 0;
			end else begin
				counter <= counter + 1;
			end
		end
		always @(posedge clk) begin
			if(counter >= PERIOD/2 - 1) begin
				clk <= ~clk;
			end
		end
	endlogic_description
	
	<implementation></implementation>
	
</module>
